source_snapshot.procedure: Fully populate CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network slots, power on and boot the OS, clear BMC/OS logs, check no baseline error, and run AC power cycles for 48 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: No BMC/system error, hang/blue screen, or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A person or PDU performs 1000 AC cycles over 48 hours; after each boot an insecure SSH command returns uptime, a truncated dmesg error tail and an lspci line count.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that a fully populated server survives exactly 1000 AC off/on cycles within the defined 48-hour campaign without boot failure, hang/blue screen, persistent device loss, unexpected host/BMC errors, or unrecovered hardware state.
original_test_intent.target: The complete approved SUT population—CPU, DIMM, storage, GPU, network, BMC and associated power path—controlled by a qualified AC-cycle fixture/PDU.
original_test_intent.scope: One traceable campaign of 1000 physical AC power removals/restorations over 48 hours, with per-cycle boot and identity-based inventory/health evidence and final recovery; an OS reboot or DC reset is not equivalent.
original_test_intent.operation: A qualified operator installs and validates the fixture; an approved controller or operator performs the exact AC cadence; the harness records PDU state and validates BMC/POST/OS reachability, stable device identities and new errors after every cycle.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Exactly 1000 completed cycles within a 48-hour campaign. Off dwell, on dwell, boot timeout, health-check timeout, retry policy and whether failed attempts count are undefined; the average total budget is 172.8 seconds per cycle.
original_test_intent.expected_result: All 1000 cycles complete under the approved timing, every expected device identity returns after each boot, no prohibited host/BMC/platform error or unrecovered hang occurs, and final configuration/data/health checks pass.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Approved full device manifest, fixture/PDU identity and interlocks, campaign/cycle counters and timestamps, actual off/on state proof, POST/boot/OOB/OS status, identity-based inventory diff, complete incremental host/BMC logs, failure/retry accounting, data-health checks and final recovered state.
ambiguities: Off/on dwell, boot timeout, health probes, allowable retries, failed-cycle counting and 48-hour scheduling are absent.
`full` slot population requires a platform recipe and stable device manifest.
`no error` and workable/hang criteria need allowed-event and timeout definitions.
Clearing logs conflicts with evidence preservation and is unnecessary when timestamped or cursor-based deltas are available.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly preserves 1000 cycles/48 hours, prohibits uncontrolled remote AC, requires an approved fixture/operator, interlocks, per-cycle evidence, no log clearing, data safeguards and OOB recovery. It classifies the entire case MANUAL ONLY even though an approved programmable PDU and automated per-cycle validator are a reasonable hybrid implementation, and it accepts device count as evidence rather than stable identity matching.

applicable_history.decision: Hybrid manual fixture setup plus automated control/evidence collection is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; high-risk or approval-gated operation is not MANUAL ONLY by itself.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The fixture installation, wiring/interlock inspection and final physical recovery require a qualified operator, but an approved programmable PDU can execute the fixed campaign while the harness automatically validates every cycle. V3 reclassifies this hybrid capability without authorizing AC control or relaxing any safety gate.

available_now: The exact 1000-cycle count, 48-hour campaign, fully populated target scope and principal failure criteria are explicit.
Read-only device-manifest, firmware, active workload, data/backups, baseline health/logs and OOB/fixture reachability can be collected before any power control is armed.
missing_inputs: Approved full-population manifest with stable CPU/DIMM/storage/GPU/NIC identities and expected per-cycle visibility
Qualified PDU/fixture model, wiring, outlet/SUT mapping, current capacity, interlocks, independent emergency stop, controller interface and authoritative proof of actual AC loss/restoration
Off/on dwell, discharge requirement, BMC/POST/OS boot and health timeouts, retry/counting policy, 1000-within-48-hour schedule, permissible events and exact failure rules
Data-integrity/backup boundary, workload evacuation, SEL/OS delta method, evidence storage independent of SUT, monitoring, OOB/physical recovery, operator coverage and explicit approval
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform reliability owner supplies cycle timing/counting/health criteria and full manifest; the lab electrical/safety owner qualifies the fixture/wiring/interlocks; service/data owners approve evacuation, data risk, campaign and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Capture stable device identities and topology, firmware/driver/BMC/BIOS state, storage/data/backup status, active workloads, existing host/BMC/SEL errors and time synchronization without clearing logs
Verify PDU inventory/outlet mapping and controller read-only state, OOB/KVM reachability, independent evidence destination and emergency-stop procedure without toggling power
prohibited_until_closed: Do not arm or toggle AC, use a host reboot as a substitute, run on active/production data, clear logs, embed credentials, bypass host verification, or let an agent infer dwell/retry/counting rules

Do not count an attempted or failed boot as a completed cycle, accept lspci line count as device identity proof, truncate error evidence, or declare completion before all 1000 traceable cycles and final recovery
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Electrical/lab owners physically sign off wiring, load and interlocks; reliability owner signs the immutable schedule/state machine and stable manifest; a non-power dry run validates evidence, timeouts and emergency stop; protected evidence and OOB/physical recovery are independently reachable.

revision_candidate.purpose: Execute exactly 1000 approved physical AC off/on cycles over 48 hours on the fully populated SUT and verify per-cycle boot, complete device identity, error-free health and final recovery.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Dedicated fully populated server with signed hardware/firmware recipe, qualified programmable PDU or supervised fixture, independent evidence storage, BMC/OOB/KVM, safe electrical capacity, backups and a staffed recovery window.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The entire SUT and its actual AC input path, including every expected CPU, DIMM, storage device, GPU and NIC identity. An OS reboot, BMC reset or DC cycle is not an AC-cycle substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Stable full-device manifest; PDU/fixture/wiring/outlet/interlock qualification; off/on/discharge/boot/health timing; retry and failed-cycle accounting; 1000/48-hour schedule; allowed events; data/backups; maintenance approval; independent logging; abort limits; OOB/physical recovery and responsible operators.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After operator fixture sign-off and an immutable state-machine review, perform AC OFF, confirm actual loss, wait the approved off dwell, restore AC, confirm power/POST/BMC/OS milestones, run the complete identity and health validator, store evidence outside the SUT, and increment the completed-cycle counter only when the owner-defined state succeeds. Repeat through completed cycle 1000 within the approved 48-hour campaign.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Full population matches recipe, SUT is dedicated and backed up, fixture load/interlocks/emergency stop pass, logs are preserved, stable device baseline and allowable events are signed, clocks synchronized, evidence path/OOB/physical recovery tested, and campaign explicitly approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Fixture and approval records; immutable schedule/profile; cycle 1-1000 state transitions and timestamps; off/on confirmation; boot/POST/OOB/OS outcomes; stable identity diff for every device class; complete incremental BMC/SEL/kernel/OS error evidence; retry/failure ledger; health/data checks; final inventory and restored nominal state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed platform population and reliability plan defining 1000 completed AC cycles within 48 hours, timing, allowable events, boot/health timeouts, device identities, failed-cycle policy, data-integrity checks and final recovery.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No unqualified wiring/PDU, unattended unbounded toggling, production workload, log clearing, evidence stored only on the SUT, guessed timing/retry, auto-bypass after fault, or automatic repair/reboot outside the state machine. Emergency stop must remain independent.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit electrical/lab, reliability, service/data and recovery approval is required before arming; a qualified operator installs/inspects the fixture and remains available under the approved coverage plan.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Fixture wiring/interlock sign-off and physical recovery are manual. Once approved, PDU control, state monitoring, per-cycle health checks, inventory diffs and evidence accounting can be automated by the validated harness.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On fault, de-arm/stop the fixture safely, preserve the current state and all cycle evidence, use OOB then physical recovery as approved, verify electrical safety/data/device health, restore nominal power/configuration and do not resume or adjust counts without owner disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsafe load/wiring/fixture/interlock, wrong outlet/SUT, lost evidence or time sync, failed AC-state confirmation, boot/POST/OS timeout, hang/BSOD, missing/replaced device identity, new prohibited BMC/kernel/storage/GPU/network error, data-integrity fault, thermal/power issue, management loss, failed emergency stop, or schedule/count inconsistency.

identified_defects: V2's MANUAL ONLY classification ignores a reasonable approved programmable-PDU plus automated-validation implementation.
The source does not define cycle state/timing or failed-cycle counting needed to reconcile 1000 iterations with 48 hours.
DeepSeek's lspci line count can miss device substitution or compensate one missing device with another.
DeepSeek truncates logs and uses insecure credentials/host-key handling; the source asks to clear evidence logs.
reason_for_change: Represent the real hybrid capability and make every disruptive cycle auditable without allowing autonomous power control before a qualified fixture, deterministic timing and emergency/recovery controls exist.

new_technical_evidence.title: Platform-specific AC-cycle fixture evidence required
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Exact PDU, server PSU topology and lab electrical controls are not identified
new_technical_evidence.supports: No universal remote power command or dwell time can be supplied safely from the testcase text.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All electrical limits, AC-loss detection, discharge timing, boot thresholds and fixture APIs require the lab/platform SOP.

removed_ambiguities: Defines completion as 1000 successful state-machine cycles, not 1000 attempts.
Preserves both 1000 iterations and the 48-hour campaign and exposes the 172.8-second average budget for owner scheduling.
Replaces device count with stable identity matching and separates physical fixture work from automatable control/evidence.
resolved_blockers: Physical/high-risk power action is not treated as permanently manual when an approved controllable fixture and human setup can be provided.
remaining_blockers: No AC action may occur until fixture qualification, deterministic cycle/count rules, full manifest, data boundary, approvals, stop controls and recovery are verified.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects the capability classification to the defined hybrid category, adds deterministic 1000/48-hour cycle accounting and identity-based no-device-loss evidence, and still forbids any power action until all V2 electrical, operator, data and recovery protections are satisfied.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator preserved exactly 1000 physical AC cycles within the 48-hour campaign, fully populated stable-identity checks, manual PDU boundaries and per-cycle recovery evidence.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The title requires 1000 AC cycles and the procedure specifies a 48-hour campaign on a fully populated SUT.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects physical power safety but labels the whole case manual; V3 preserves manual fixture work and recognizes controlled execution/evidence automation.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No AC toggle without signed electrical fixture/state machine; every successful cycle needs independent power proof, boot milestones, stable device identities, complete log deltas and emergency recovery.
